race.comment: BLINK AND MISS (7) has a terrific record this trip with two wins and one placing from three starts. Placed last time (18.93) at this track in a SE, finishing second and beaten 1.3 lengths. Makes strong appeal on best. SMART AS YOU (1) hit the ground running and set it up early clocking 18.86 with a 1.3 lengths win at this track over 350m. Has a solid record from this box including two wins and a minor placing. Expected to measure up again. BIG AL'S (2) is having his first look at this circuit. Scored in best time on card (19.45) latest winning by a neck at Capalaba in a OPEN. Has won two of five starts from this draw. Flying at the moment and expecting another big run. SECRET STORY (8) hit the frame latest (19.47) when second at Capalaba in a OPEN. Has already won seven times from this draw.
